name: 137.2 — found where it is drawn
author: brodgar
description: Self-checking suite for task 137.2: the item role and widget:items() reach a crafting recipe's slots as well as a container's cells, one door seeds every icon there is, a recipe's quality inputs and tools are not among them, a real container is unchanged, a slot whose icon is destroyed goes stale and leaves the role's listing, and the slots of the recipe that replaces it are announced.
